auth.faqWhyQ: Why do I need to pay $7.95/month?
auth.faqWhyA: The Speakeasy is built to be the best place to meet, match, and craft together. Your membership unlocks dedicated video rooms, the Match Maker, the matching calendar, and priority events. Cancel anytime in one click — no trailing charges.
auth.faqSwitchQ: Can I switch or cancel my plan?
auth.faqSwitchA: Yes. Once you're signed in, go to Account → Membership to switch or cancel your subscription at any time.
auth.faqPromoA: $7.95/month is the promotional early-bird rate for the Hooking Up plan. The standard rate is $17.95/month, so lock it in while the promotion lasts.
auth.faqMovingQ: What do I get with Moving In?
auth.faqMovingA: Moving In is the global host membership: create rooms and groups, host parties, and get featured up front. It's $17.95/month or $179.50/year.

landing.heroSub: Secret Yarnery gives you live rooms, courses, events, gamification, monetization and real conversations — all in one platform you fully control.
landing.freeTrial: 14-day free trial · no credit card required
landing.valueLead: Everything you need to run and participate in a thriving community
landing.whatYouGetDesc: No more switching between 10 different tools. Your community, your courses, your events — all in one place.
landing.feature1Desc: Create always-on community rooms or schedule live events. Members join from any device — mobile, tablet, desktop. Admin controls for music, recording and moderation.
landing.feature2Desc: A central wall where members connect — share updates, photos, polls and questions with reactions, threaded replies and bookmarks built in.
landing.feature3Desc: Structured video courses with lessons, progress tracking and completion badges. Members pick up right where they left off — on any device.
landing.feature4Desc: Schedule events, send reminders, track RSVPs. Members see what's coming up and never miss a live session.
landing.feature5Desc: Run crochet-along sessions with project sharing, progress tracking, streaks and recognition that keep members crafting together.
landing.feature6Desc: Create smaller groups for focused conversations, cohorts or special interest topics. Members find their people.
landing.feature7Desc: Long-form articles with rich editing, drafts, publishing and RSS. Build a content library that lives inside your community.
landing.feature8Desc: Subscriptions with promo codes and income tracking. Real-time analytics on growth, engagement and revenue.
landing.communityAllInOne: Your community, all in one place.
landing.communityDesc: Move between live conversations, learning, events and community interaction without juggling separate platforms. Everything your membership needs lives on one platform.
landing.liveVideoRoomsDesc: Talk face-to-face with members in real time, from any device.
landing.coursesLearningDesc: Work through video lessons at your own pace and track your progress.
landing.eventsCommunityDesc: Discover upcoming events, RSVP and show up alongside the community.
landing.groupsConversationsDesc: Join smaller groups and keep the conversation going beyond the rooms.
landing.meetFaceToFaceDesc: Join live rooms, talk in real time and interact with the community.
landing.roomDesc: A warm evening of sharing projects, tips and encouragement with the community.
landing.roomAria: Live community room preview with speakers and live chat
landing.chatMsg1: So lovely to see tonight's circle all together.
landing.chatMsg2: Just finished the ripple blanket, everyone!
landing.chatMsg4: Adding the border now — only two rows to go.
landing.learnAtOwnPaceDesc: Courses with structured video lessons. Your progress is saved, so you can pick up right where you left off — whenever it suits you.
landing.membershipDesc: Simple monthly memberships that grow with you. Start free and unlock more as you go.
landing.includesEverythingInOtherPlans: Everything in the other plans, plus:
landing.neverMissDesc: Discover upcoming community events, RSVP and get reminders — so you can show up for what matters.
landing.rsvpToJoin: RSVP to join the community live
landing.moreThanVideoCallDesc: Secret Yarnery brings together conversations, groups, members, live rooms, learning and events — one place for everything.
